site_role: Public research demos, live monitors, decision tools and operational dashboards

monitors.name: Irish Energy Transition Monitor
monitors.summary: Electricity transition, RES-E gap, capacity watch, storage and grid flexibility.
monitors.caveat: Proposed capacity, storage and connected generation must remain analytically separate.

monitors.name: UrbanForest Radar
monitors.summary: Urban forest practice, funding, research and design risk intelligence.
monitors.caveat: News and funding items are watch signals, not endorsements.

monitors.name: NDRT River Radar
monitors.summary: River trust watch items covering grants, septic tanks, slurry timing, invasive species and practical catchment issues.
monitors.caveat: Treat as an intelligence radar requiring field and stakeholder verification.

monitors.name: Bird Sound Atlas
monitors.summary: Ear-training demo using likely nearby birds and sound examples.
monitors.caveat: Species likelihood depends on data coverage, season, location and source availability.

monitors.name: Irish Life Pension Funds
monitors.summary: Fund valuation scrape and display utility.
